verdict.rationale: Greenhouse markets talent sourcing/CRM capabilities — pools, bulk outreach campaigns with personalization and texting (via Grayscale), and unlimited CRM events — which map to prospect pools and nurture campaigns. However, evidence lacks detail on email sequence tracking (opens/clicks), multi-touch cadence automation, or long-term nurture workflows for future roles beyond high-level marketing claims. Missing for 10: documented email sequence/tracking mechanics, nurture campaign workflow detail, independent/hands-on validation of CRM sourcing features.
